{
  "phoneNote": "Readable typography and a well-sized headline work, but repeated contact details and a long, entirely text-based page weaken the presentation of the craft.",
  "desktopNote": "The restrained editorial layout feels considered, but oversized typography and broad empty bands outweigh the actual furniture-making work.",
  "phone": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "desktop": {
    "impression": 3,
    "hierarchy": 4,
    "imagery": 3,
    "spacing": 3,
    "clutter": 2,
    "distinctiveness": 3
  },
  "fixes": [
    "Correct the sticky header positioning: in the full-page views it interrupts the phone hero and overlays the desktop headline and address.",
    "Consolidate the address and opening hours into one contact section rather than repeating the hero contact block near the footer; retain the required phone action bar.",
    "Introduce a prominent finished-project photograph and a compact selection of work, replacing some text-only space; reduce the oversized desktop year and section padding."
  ],
  "blockers": [
    "Desktop full-page hero: the navigation header overlaps and obscures the headline and address.",
    "Phone and desktop: the address, directions and opening-hours block is repeated in the hero and near the footer."
  ]
}
